					check_variable = { num_equipment@amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 0 }
					check_variable = { num_target_equipment_in_armies@amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 0 }
				}
			}
			ar_eq_field_15_visible = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { num_equipment@amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 0 }
					check_variable = { num_target_equipment_in_armies@amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 0 }
				}
				NOT = { check_variable = { var = num_equipment_in_armies@amphibious_mechanized_equipment value = num_target_equipment_in_armies@amphibious_mechanized_equipment compare = less_than } }
			}
			ar_eq_short_15_visible = {
				check_variable = { var = num_equipment_in_armies@amphibious_mechanized_equipment value = num_target_equipment_in_armies@amphibious_mechanized_equipment compare = less_than }
			}
			ar_eq_bar_15_visible = {
				check_variable = { num_target_equipment_in_armies@amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 0 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_ar_counted > 0 }
			}
			ar_al_none_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_ar_leaders^num < 1 }
			}
			ar_row_fighting_visible = {
				check_variable = { num_units_in_combat > 0 }
			}
			ar_row_inf_visible = {
				check_variable = { num_infantry > 0 }
			}
			ar_row_arm_visible = {
				check_variable = { num_armored > 0 }
			}
			ar_row_mot_visible = {
				check_variable = { num_motorized > 0 }
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}

	mod1440_army_readiness_handle = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "mod1440_army_readiness_handle"
		parent_window_token = deployment_tab

		visible = {
			check_variable = { mod1440_ar_folded = 1 }
		}

		effects = {
			ar_unfold_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_ar_folded = 0 }
				mod1440_ar_count = yes
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}
}
